author: IcyCode
body:
(This post was previously locked because of a flame war. I have put it in again as Para requested download for it)
Hey here again with a map based off my ideas from Hazardous. ParaSpider said that Hazardous may make a good Red Alert map with some changes so here we are. The name disastrous is kindof a sequal to the Hazardous map as Disasters come after Hazards! So here we go again. I present to you Disastrous:
Map YAML: http://pastie.org/9368286
Map Download: https://github.com/Fennercraft/Maps  (Mediafire has broke for me so I now use github)
Picture Album: http://imgur.com/a/GKKf6
Thanks again,
subzero110

P.S. Please use constructive criticism so I know how to improve my maps further. Comments such as, "-1 Don't Like it" are not appreciated. By all means put -1 but explain proper reasoning. Thanks :D
